body.label: Target
body.html: One space within 3 units; up to three willing creatures within 1 unit of it.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Mark the point until the start of your next turn. Each target becomes Rallied and suppresses one ordinary morale-based Success Die penalty while within 1 unit of it.

surges.html: One target may move 2 units toward the point.
Each target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 while beside the point until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Authority - Standard
rider.html: Spend this Authority when one marked target would lose Rallied from a Core Wound before your next turn: preserve Rallied until its original expiration; the Wound still applies.
